summary: Real-runtime e2e of daemon-less lifecycle/proposal automation (AlembicPlugin runtime, build:core live ../AlembicCore @62f0b4b, ALEMBIC_HOME sandbox, real cc bootstrap->stdio MCP, tick = real alembic_status firing staging-access-sweep, shared cap=3). Seeded real DB (raw better-sqlite3, backdated) + drove 6 ticks, snapshotting DB each tick. VERDICT: 5/6 PASS, check ④ FAIL with one reproducible product defect (F-A) to route. (1)PASS staging: checkAndPromote ONLY promotes staging, cap-bounded oldest-first (promote 3/3/1 over 3 ticks, stg-01..07 by createdAt), non-autoApprovable + future-deadline staging stayed waiting, checkTimeouts never touched staging. (2)PASS evolving>7d->active w/ lifecycle_transition_events trigger=timeout-recovery. (3)PASS pending/decaying>30d->deprecated; pnd-fresh(5d) stayed pending. (5)PASS per-sweep cap bound (promote<=3, checkTimeouts shared-budget<=3 scanned, observing<=3), backlog drained across multiple ticks not one cold scan. (6)PASS gates held: no-usage update rejected 'no usage during observation', FP update rejected, deprecate-without-decay rejected, unexpired pending proposal stayed pending while >14d expired. (4)FAIL positive execution: all 5 observing proposals were sweep-driven to terminal state (observing->rejected, bounded) proving checkAndExecute is live, BUT none reached 'executed' and 0 deprecated_by edges. F-A (defect, reproducible even with a single isolated proposal): every UPDATE proposal self-races to rejected 'Invalid transition: evolving -> evolving' — the sweep's own active->evolving transition emits a lifecycle signal that the init-registered subscribeToSignals subscriber (KnowledgeModule.ts:406) re-enters on the still-observing proposal, so the entry completes active->evolving->active once but the proposal is mislabeled rejected instead of executed. Unit tests mock the two tracks separately, so only real-runtime e2e exposes it. F-B (observation): deprecate proposals rejected 'decay slowed: decayScore=50' because decayScore isn't preserved through KnowledgeEntry stats canonicalization (#collectRecipeMetrics reads ??50 default), so deprecate-execute isn't reachable from seeded state (gate correctly refused). Non-resident invariant held (sandbox tree = bootstrap+host-mcp only, clean exit, no daemon). Isolation held (sandbox workspace 2b74bdf3 absent from real ~/.asd). Test changed NO product code (AlembicPlugin 799ceac / AlembicCore 62f0b4b clean). Controller action: route F-A to owning repo (AlembicCore ProposalExecutor + AlembicPlugin dual-track wiring); Design/Core to rule F-B scope. Test does not fix product code.

risks: F-A (route to owning repo): UPDATE proposal execution mislabeled executed->rejected under dual-track (init-signal subscriber + bounded sweep) re-entrancy; entry state stays consistent but proposal accounting is wrong and the requirement goal 'updates 活起来' is unmet. Mechanism: ProposalExecutor.subscribeToSignals:85 / #onSignal:118 (status still 'observing' mid-flight) / #executeUpdate:335 (transition emits signal at :353, markExecuted only at :399) + LifecycleStateMachine.transition guard :128; wired in AlembicPlugin KnowledgeModule.ts:406. Reproducible with a single isolated proposal.

F-B (needs Design/Core decision): decayScore not preserved through KnowledgeEntry stats canonicalization -> ProposalExecutor.#collectRecipeMetrics reads ??50 default, so deprecate dead/severe execution path not reachable from seeded entry state (may not fire in normal op without a DecayDetector pass). deprecated_by edge path therefore not exercised.
